Several sources read one pass: tiles share io_concurrency cpu_workers. separate sets combine; names src label sources. resolution Integer scalar A5 resolution (0–29). Resolution 30 refused now: A5 returns resolution-29 cells points 30. stat Aggregation. One "mean", "sum", "count", "min", "max", "var", "sd", "majority", "fractions", "npix", non-duplicated subset (except "fractions", must alone) one-pass multi-stat read. Default "mean". "var" / "sd" use sample formula (divisor n - 1) computed via Welford's online algorithm streaming aggregator, matching stats::var() / stats::sd(); cells covered single pixel return NA. "npix" per cell rather per band: single npix column number source pixels least one valid band (mode = "overlay", summed pixel-area weight). validity across bands, dataset-wide nodata sentinel, equals every <band>_count column, stat = c("mean", "npix") carries weights later merge one column instead one per band. available mode = "centroid". "majority" "fractions" categorical: treat raw integer codes class labels, require integer source 16 bits fewer (like dequant, combined). "majority" returns class greatest total weight cell (pixel count mode = "forward", overlap area mode = "overlay"), ties broken toward smallest class code.
